method.unit: One actually editable production tile at the initial 25x25 local-battle editor state. This is one render/interaction root cause affecting 527 targets, not 527 independent implementation defects.
method.excluded: 98 non-editable border/player/exit tiles; repeat sizes, modes, widths, support changes, tests and CI are not additional findings.
method.checkType: Custom keyboard-operability evidence, not axe-reported violations. Baseline axe found no violations while native focus failed.
method.randomness: Production maze generation remains random. The initial editable coordinate set is fixed; native reachability is checked independently of terrain content. Stored baseline and final sampled maps need not have identical walls.
method.priorOverlap: No previous Formwheel_Maze editor keyboard-operability findings. Existing board ARIA and input-boundary findings are separate and not recounted.

repair.primary: Create named native buttons only for valid editor tiles, with roving focus and keyboard activation.
uncountedSupport: Arrow/Home/End navigation and complete focused-target reveal
At least 28px editor targets with contained scrolling
Focus handoff to status after committing an edit
Move the return-to-top button outside the board to prevent overlap

interactions: Tab entry and a single tab stop
Arrow/Home/End focus navigation without moving the runner
527-point native keyboard traversal and hit tests
Space/Enter wall edits across successive turns
validation.network: Only local production assets. External HTTP and WebSockets blocked, service workers disabled, no account or database operations.
validation.checks: Maze 3 inline scripts, root syntax 154 blocks/files, catalog, 55-page skip navigation and 11 Node test files passed.
validation.ci: Dedicated root CI job checks out the exact Maze fix commit. New PR run pending at report creation.

limits: The count covers the observed 25x25 initial editor targets, even though all four sizes are repaired.
No claim that all maze rules, bot tactics or generated layouts are fully verified.
Automated geometry, names and keyboard tests do not replace real-device or screen-reader usability review.
